lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Friend...

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: By chance, are you a fan of nice, cozy blankets?
I guess so, yeah.
I don't really have strong feelings either way.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Oh, perfect!

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Then, this is the perfect chance to find out whether you like them or not!
What do you mean?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I'm watching a home shopping channel right now.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: And, oh my goodness!

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: There's this cozy blanket set I'm buying that comes with two fluffy pillows,

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: and it's on sale right now!

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: So I figured I'd get some for my friends too!
Wait, what is it you're buying, exactly?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I can't get just one for you though...

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: The others would feel left out, of course.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I should get some for my friends in the Counters, too.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I'll just order enough pillows and blankets for four people and have it shipped over.
Hey, hang on! Slow down.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Yes?
For one thing, we really don't need that many blankets.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: They look so incredibly cozy though!

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Apparently, they've been certified by the Warm and Snuggly Association.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Doesn't that name just make you feel cozy already?
I've never heard of that organization.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Well, it's not like you or I pay much attention to things of that nature,

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: so it makes sense that we wouldn't be familiar with it.
Still, impulse buying like this isn't a great idea.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Oh, is that so?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: But it's much cheaper than what you'd get at retail.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Nearly 70% off!

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: And it's a one-time offer. It won't be this cheap again!
That's just one of their sales tactics.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Mhmmm...

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I'm still a bit reluctant to give up on it, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I really think you'd love it.
Have you looked it up online?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: The blanket, you mean?
Yeah, it might be cheaper online.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I can look up that sort of thing online?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: How does that work?
Don't worry about it. I'll look it up for you.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: You will?
Yeah, I'll handle it. Just hold on.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: The order window closes in 30 minutes though.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Is that enough time?
Yeah. Just sit tight.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Please don't trouble yourself, Friend!

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I'd hate to inconvenience you.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I'll call their customer service number

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: and ask them directly if this is really the best price.
Like they'd ever admit that it wasn't.
Just slow down and tell me the full name of the product.
Snow Crane doesn't reply.
Snow Crane?
Still nothing.
You're on the phone with them right now, aren't you...?
Something tells me a blanket is going to show up at the door soon.
